final_topology.title: Secure Government Data Center
final_topology.description: A secure government data center with a DMZ, load-balanced web servers, and segmented production, staging, and management zones.
final_topology.topology_summary: The topology includes a screened DMZ with a WAF and load-balanced web servers. The core application and database servers are in a production zone, while internal firewalls segment the staging and management networks. Redundant connectivity, content filtering, and SIEM integration are provided.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones and nodes, including servers, firewalls, and management systems, which strongly imply an asset inventory is maintained.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n_new2) with links to various nodes and zones, indicating that data flows are documented.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for DMZ, Production, Staging, Management, and DR Site, which implies data processing and storage are segmented based on sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) and a WAF (n1), which are used to protect servers in different zones.

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes DNS servers (n22, n23) that are connected to the edge router (n13), implying that trusted DNS servers are configured on enterprise assets.

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n24) and a remote access management service (n_struct3), which implies that MFA is required for remote network access.

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a DNS filter (n25) and a web proxy (n26), which are connected to the edge router (n13), implying that DNS filtering services are used.

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a web proxy (n26) and a content filter (n16), which are connected to the edge router (n13), implying that network-based URL filters are enforced.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture
controls.evidence: The topology includes a well-defined network architecture with DMZ, production, staging, management, and DR site zones, which implies a secure network architecture is established and maintained.

controls.title: Securely Manage Network Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes an asset management system (n_new1) that manages various network devices, implying that network infrastructure is securely managed.

controls.title: Centralize Network Authentication, Authorization, and Auditing (AAA)
controls.evidence: The topology includes an AAA server (n27) and a remote access management service (n_struct3), which implies that network AAA is centralized.

controls.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
controls.evidence: The topology includes a VPN service (n_new3) and a remote access management service (n_struct3), which implies that remote devices utilize a VPN and connect to the enterprise’s AAA infrastructure.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Dedicated Computing Resources for All Administrative Work
controls.evidence: The topology includes a management zone (z4) with a management server (n12) and admin workstations (n32, n33), which implies dedicated computing resources for administrative work.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Detection Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIDS (n28) and a SIEM (n14), which implies that a network intrusion detection solution is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Traffic Filtering Between Network Segments
controls.evidence: The topology includes internal firewalls (n5, n6, n9, n11) and a WAF (n1), which perform traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes an MFA server (n24), a remote access management service (n_struct3), and a remote access policy manager (n_new4), which implies that access control for remote assets is managed.

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs
controls.evidence: The topology includes a SIEM (n14) and a NIDS (n28), which collect network traffic flow logs.

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NIPS (n29), which implies that a network intrusion prevention solution is deployed.

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control
controls.evidence: The topology includes a NAC (n30), which implies that port-level access control is deployed.

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering
controls.evidence: The topology includes an application firewall (n31) and a web proxy (n26), which perform application layer filtering.

controls.title: Separate Production and Non-Production Systems
controls.evidence: The topology includes distinct zones for production (z2) and non-production (staging z3, management z4, DR site z5), which implies that production and non-production systems are separated.

controls.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
controls.evidence: The topology includes a penetration testing service (n_new5) and links to various zones, which implies that periodic external penetration tests are performed.

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z7 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.

findings_before.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes various zones and nodes, but there is no explicit evidence of an asset inventory system or process.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit asset inventory system or process is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an asset management system and links to all other nodes.

findings_before.title: Document Data Flows
findings_before.evidence: The topology shows various zones and links, but there is no explicit documentation of data flows.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit data flow documentation is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a data flow documentation system and links to relevant zones and nodes.

findings_before.title: Ensure Remote Devices Utilize a VPN and are Connecting to an Enterprise’s AAA Infrastructure
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a remote access management service (n_struct3) and links to the internal firewall (n5), but there is no explicit evidence of a VPN.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit VPN node or links are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a VPN service and links to the remote access management service and internal firewall.

findings_before.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes a remote access management service (n_struct3) and links to the internal firewall (n5), but there is no explicit evidence of access control policies.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit access control policies or mechanisms are shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing an access control policy management system and links to the remote access management service and internal firewall.

findings_before.title: Perform Periodic External Penetration Tests
findings_before.evidence: The topology includes an external testing zone (z7) and links to the DMZ (z1), but there is no explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests.
findings_before.missing_reason: No explicit evidence of periodic external penetration tests is shown in the topology.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add a node representing a penetration testing service and links to the external testing zone and DMZ.
